piece.headline: Ahmad edges Bhavik for top spot on a Free Hit
piece.standfirst: Ahmad leads Bhavik by 1 point after a Free Hit week, while Raushan's 74 was the best score of the gameweek.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Will's 3-in, 3-out rejig cost 22 points in hits. He still posted 71, the second best score of the week. Nerve rewarded.
piece.one_to_watch: Ahmad leads Bhavik by 1 point. Sid and Nanik are level on the Gold line, so one bench blunder could swing a place.

winners.name: Will
winners.verdict: Will took a hefty hit on transfers and still had the second best week. Gutsy, and it paid off. Up 9 places.

winners.name: Hishaan
winners.verdict: Hishaan took a hit for M.Sangaré and it paid off. Up 9 places to 9th. Quiet work, loud result.

losers.name: Naishadh
losers.verdict: Naishadh paid 8 in hits for Foden and Wissa, then still posted the worst score of the week. Brutal.

losers.name: Nanik
losers.verdict: Nanik played the Wildcard, then left 17 points on the bench. The reset needed a better team sheet.

losers.name: Nihal
losers.verdict: Nihal's Wildcard came with a drop of 6 places to 22nd. The reset changed nothing.
